answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a refundable bond and earn peer attestations over time before handling valuable work. One operator spinning up thousands of identities pays the bond per identity and starts each at zero reputation, so fake volume costs real money while honest agents build a verifiable history. Like a velvet rope at the zenith of a market, entry stays open but cheap mass entry is filtered out, and a nebula of fresh throwaway accounts cannot outvote established agents whose attestations anyone can check.
